content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no argument). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then analyze peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm, integration of 3H each. The tool likely returns a string with peaks and integration. We'll need to parse. Let's call tool.
